bottleneck_measurements_first_instrument.shader_compiles_backboardd: 17 sampled calls; call37 = 19.4s single shader (r388 saw 15.5s/15.1s/9.9s at boot). Multi-second compiles are real and recur inside the working session; pipeline cache is weak_ref mem_cache only (disk cache disabled in this Meson build), so eviction with pipeline destruction forces recompiles.

The synchronous submit+wait serializes the CPU presenter against full GPU completion of large batch sets.
